title: What running a marathon does
description:
How your heart, energy stores and muscles react as marathon miles add up.
#marathon #running #science #fitness
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Echoes of Time" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens if you run a marathon?
lines.b1: Five miles in, your heart rate climbs and breathing quickens.
lines.b2: By mile thirteen, your heart pumps harder to hold pace.
lines.b3: Around mile twenty, stored glycogen runs low, and you hit the wall.
lines.b4: By mile twenty-four, heavy sweat can leave you dehydrated.
lines.b5: At the finish, sore muscles remind you of every mile.
lines.end: Would you ever run a full marathon?
